title: Degraded availability for GPT-5.3 Codex and GPT-5.6 models in Copilot
summary: This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available.

timeline.body: We are experiencing degraded availability for GPT-5.3 Codex, GPT-5.6 Luna, and GPT-5.6 Sol in Copilot products and IDE surfaces due to an issue with an upstream model provider. We recommend choosing another model or selecting Auto to continue using Copilot until the issue is resolved.
